infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Recall needs access to your photo library to save and organize your memories.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Recall needs access to your camera to capture photos and add them to your memories.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Recall uses your location to tag memories with where they happened and to help you find recalls by place.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Recall needs permission to save images to your photo library.
